verdict.rationale: Agents connect through Intuit's official OAuth 2.0 flow with token management and refresh, and can be pointed at an isolated sandbox environment. The official MCP server limits what an agent can do through client-side toggles (QUICKBOOKS_DISABLE_WRITE, QUICKBOOKS_DISABLE_UPDATE) and by restricting which tool categories are registered. However, this least-privilege control is configured in the MCP server rather than enforced on the credential itself, and custom user roles cover human users, not API tokens. Missing for 10: documented granular OAuth scopes or permission-limited API credentials issued per agent, server-side enforcement of read-only or entity-level access on tokens, and independent hands-on corroboration.
